purpose: Define the smallest open-world semantic contract needed to project heterogeneous Workspace Control work into a common query/routing surface without replacing project-local truth or creating execution authority.
principles: The semantic representation is rebuildable unless a separately reviewed contract explicitly states otherwise.
Semantic/model inference never creates or widens execution authority.
The stable core remains small; domain-specific meaning is added through versioned extensions.
Unknown extensions fail structurally rather than being guessed into a known domain.
Every material assertion retains exact provenance and temporal/supersession metadata.
Contradictory assertions may coexist; current-state views must not silently erase disagreement.
Execution, artifact correctness, scientific support, tutoring mastery, and external delivery remain distinct states.

epistemic.purpose: What is observed, claimed, inferred, supported, contradicted, unresolved, or decided as knowledge.

intent_and_work.purpose: What outcome is desired and what work structure is proposed or represented.

normative.purpose: Authority-owned permission, prohibition, review, scope, consequence and gate semantics.
normative.critical_rule: No MODEL_INFERRED or EPISTEMIC_ONLY assertion may create/widen Permission, remove Prohibition, satisfy ReviewRequirement, or turn a CandidateAction into executable authority.

execution.purpose: What was actually attempted, waited on, completed, validated, produced, or received.

resource_and_executor.purpose: What capabilities/resources/executor surfaces are available and what a work item requires.

decision_bridge.purpose: Bridge proposed work to deterministic eligibility/authority/routing decisions.
rules: EligibilityEvaluation may derive readiness/dependency/capability facts but not grant permission.
AuthorityDecision must reference an existing authority-owned policy/task contract/evaluator.
RoutingDecision selects among already-eligible executors and does not widen action authority.

assertion_metadata_contract.provenance_rule: Every assertion has at least one exact source reference; deterministic/model-derived assertions retain immediate parent assertion IDs.
assertion_metadata_contract.contradiction_rule: Contradictory assertions remain simultaneously representable with provenance and temporal context.
assertion_metadata_contract.supersession_rule: Supersession affects current-view selection but never deletes historical assertions.

provenance_alignment.note: PROV-O is conceptual prior art; v0.1 does not require RDF storage.

may_not: replace project-local authoritative sources without explicit migration authority
make unknown extension data executable by fallback guessing
extension_contract.core_kernel_rule: Adding a conforming domain/workflow extension must not require adding an if/elif/switch branch on domain identity to the generic scheduler/execution kernel.

workflow_projection_contract.rule: The generic scheduler consumes these fields; domain-specific meaning remains in the extension/owner.

storage_boundary.reason: Validate semantic and routing utility before selecting a physical graph technology.

acceptance_tests_before_freeze: Represent research, tutoring, publication, presentation, engineering and data-science fixtures without changing core type/dispatch code.
Add one previously unseen synthetic extension and workflow without kernel change.
Reject an extension that attempts to infer Permission.
Preserve two contradictory assertions in the same current query context.
Rebuild projection deterministically from authoritative fixtures.
Produce bounded context slice for one resumable reasoning process.
Trace one artifact/result through source -> work -> attempt -> validation.
